facts: Current and legacy single-chip Bitaxe boards use the standard Bitaxe stand footprint.
The Bitaxe Gamma Stand and Bitaxe Stand STL downloads support these boards.
The Bitaxe Gamma Duo 650 is compatible with the standard Bitaxe display-stand footprint.
The Solo Satoshi Bitaxe Gamma Duo 650 package includes the compatible Solo Satoshi 40W 5V 8A power supply.
Confirm the exact board revision before recommending a power supply.
Revision 7 and revision 6.1 use an XT30 power connection.
Older barrel-jack models require a regulated 12V supply with the correct 5.5 x 2.1 mm center-positive connector.
Revision 7 and revision 6.1 use an XT30 power connection.
The Solo Satoshi 12.4V 10A 124W power supply with an XT30 connector is the direct compatible supply for XT30-equipped NerdQaxe++ revisions.
Older barrel-jack NerdQaxe++ models require a regulated 12V supply with the correct 5.5 x 2.1 mm center-positive connector.
The Solo Satoshi 12V 10A 120W power supply with a 5.5 x 2.1 mm jack is intended for compatible older barrel-jack NerdQaxe+ and NerdQaxe++ models.
The Thermalright AXP90-X47 Full Copper is a cooling upgrade for compatible NerdQaxe++ configurations.
The Thermalright TL-9015B 92 mm slim PWM fan is compatible with the NerdQaxe++ rear-fan setup.
The LilyGo T-Display S3 H577 replacement screen is intended for compatible NerdQaxe++ boards.
The Thermalright TL-9015B 92 mm slim PWM fan is compatible with the Naja Duo rear-fan stand configuration.
The Thermalright AXP90-X47 Full Copper is a cooling upgrade for compatible Naja Duo configurations.
The Thermalright AXP90-X47 Full Copper can be used on a Bitaxe GT only with a suitable 3D-printed mounting bracket.
Do not describe the heatsink as a direct bolt-on part for the Bitaxe GT.
Use only with miners that require regulated 5V input, correct center-positive polarity, and a compatible 5.5 x 2.1 mm barrel connector.
The interchangeable regional-plug kit includes four plug heads.
Always verify the miner model, voltage, connector, polarity, and continuous-current requirement before connection.
The 16 AWG 5.5 x 2.1 mm center-positive barrel pigtail can be used in properly designed 12V miner wiring assemblies and with compatible Mean Well power supplies.
The installer must verify voltage, polarity, current, conductor sizing, terminals, insulation, strain relief, branch protection, and enclosure safety.
The US 3-prong AC plug pigtail uses 14 AWG conductors.
AC mains wiring should be performed only by a qualified person with power disconnected and in accordance with the power-supply documentation and applicable electrical codes.
Use the Solo Satoshi web flasher for supported Bitaxe and NerdAxe firmware.
The customer must select the exact miner family, model, board, and compatible firmware version.
Do not guess a board revision.
